Only `check.rs`, `body.rs` and `body/operations.rs` changed. The four other owned files and all production/tests outside this scope were untouched by this agent.

The direct Adjoint/Controlled path evaluates the actual input once in its existing order, then calls a direct-runtime judgment. Ordinary declaration Name/Specialize and transparent Repeat derive the full checked runtime group: one input's exact type or the ordered tuple of multiple input types. The group has only Q leaves and nonempty tuple nodes; declared output and actual target are compared with exact symbolic type/shape equality. Specialization uses the existing runtime Nat-decrease check only for this direct transformed call. Dependencies, principal-Unitary and recorded path masks remain required.

Opaque operation representation, static supplied providers and their basis normalization are unchanged. Repeat is transparent only when its ultimate original resolved target is an ordinary declaration; formal, primitive and other constructor operands retain the existing opaque operation path. Every repeat child/count/dependency remains checked at zero. The original-identity leaf classification, group traversal, tuple construction and temporary traversal storage are charged before their actual operations; the 1M common work/depth/type limits are unchanged.

A separate located RuntimeGroupProvider obligation binds the ordinary source provider to its original declaration/interface, complete Q-owner parameter/result shapes and derived principal Unitary fact. The existing unary Provider, FunctionEquality, Meaning and certified-clean integrity guards are unchanged. This new guard does not discharge transformation evidence, physical/native acceptance, source preservation or provider correspondence.

This is an authored frozen source delivery, not independent review or compilation evidence. No Cargo, Lean, test, CLI, native, format or Git command was executed by this agent. Parent owns formatting and actual validations; the independently owned selected concrete consumer is outside this seven-file map.
